page.title: Salvation Roblox Codes, Races & Beginner Guide
page.meta_description: Salvation is an early-alpha Roblox RPG inspired by That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime. Learn races, permadeath, bosses, loot, and code status.
page.tagline: Reincarnate into an open-world Roblox RPG where every death can leave a lasting mark.
overview: Salvation is an early-alpha Roblox RPG inspired by That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime. Your story starts with reincarnation, then opens into a dangerous world of exploration, quests, combat, bosses, dungeons, and loot. The Roblox page emphasizes permanent death: every life matters and death has lasting consequences.

The experience is built around an open world with unfamiliar lands, hidden locations and secrets, powerful enemies, and unique races with their own possibilities. You grow stronger through quests, combat, and exploration, and you can master weapons, abilities, and fighting styles. Equipment, weapons, and accessories drop as loot, while bosses and dungeons offer valuable rewards.

Salvation is marked [EARLY ALPHA] on Roblox and supports up to 20 players per server. The provided sources do not list any active Salvation Roblox codes, so no code rewards are confirmed on the Roblox store page included here.

tips: Play carefully because Salvation uses permanent death, so every fight can have lasting consequences.
Use quests, combat, and exploration together; the Roblox page lists all three as progression routes.
